notes: Scan prioritized 2026-10-23 through 2026-10-30 and extended to 30–90 days for catch-up; only the 2026-10-23 nursing review is labelled NEW. The October 27 revision of the October 18 Shi preprint is not a new publication.

All nine R1–R9 radars were queried in Consensus and cross-scanned against publisher/arXiv/conference and named researcher/lab/workshop signals. R6/R9 had no strong new standalone items; older cultural evidence was newly discovered and clearly dated.

Consensus searches were completed for R1–R9; three initially rate-limited radars were retried. The retained Melanou & Beege record was fetched in Consensus (ID 0a3333c6cf355da0991004d39707e3bd) and verified against publisher metadata. All other retained sources were read at publisher, PubMed, or arXiv primary records.
The latest main-branch Weekly remains 2026-09-29; unmerged 2026-10-16 and 2026-10-23 branches were consulted for duplicate screening. No long-lived gap status or Baseline revision is justified.

Preprint and observational findings are distinguished from causal long-term claims; the high pooled meta-analytic mean is tempered by I-squared approximately 88 percent, wide prediction intervals and small-study effects.
